name: Dynavox Group AB (publ)
summary: Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, Dynavox Group AB (publ), founded in 2012, specializes in crafting and distributing assistive technology. The company primarily assists individuals with significant communication challenges by providing bespoke augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) solutions. These innovative systems empower people living with conditions like cerebral palsy, ALS, autism spectrum disorder, and spinal cord injury to express themselves effectively and autonomously. Their holistic communication package encompasses specialized language frameworks, dedicated software, hardware devices, financial support guidance, comprehensive user assistance, and training initiatives. Dynavox Group maintains a global presence, conducting operations across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Belgium, the United States, Germany, France, China, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, and New Zealand. The company underwent a name change in July 2024, transitioning from its former identity as Tobii Dynavox AB (publ).
